semantic_fragments.content: Risk Management Results for Fixing of Wiring (clause 8.10.2): ISO14971 clauses 5.3, 5.4, 6, 7.2, 7.3, 7.4 all pass referencing Risk Management Report PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0. Clause 7.5 is N/A (no such analysis). Results confirm: hazards addressed, risks estimated, risks evaluated, risk control measures defined, recorded, verified for effectiveness and implementation, residual risk evaluated, and all residual risks acceptable.

Risk Management Results for Mechanical Protection of Wiring (clause 8.10.5): ISO14971 clauses 5.3, 5.4, 6, 7.2 all pass referencing Risk Management Report PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0. Clauses 7.3, 7.4, 7.5 have no entries recorded. Overall verdict: P.

Gap measurement supplementary note for clause 9.2.2.2: In general, gaps for adults are used, except when the device is specifically designed for use with children, in which case values for children apply. Reference standard: ISO 13852:1996 Table 20.
